fork_changes: Managed terminals and project services use your interactive shell PATH, including Go and Cloudflared.
Review this update and the previous upstream release in the new update summary, with all notes reachable when scrolling.
Start a fresh chat with another agent in the same checkout, keeping its files, env and services.
More reliable Git actions, mixed file selection, conflict confirmations, and bounded discard recovery.
Safer worktree creation and removal, env-file handoff, and service shutdown and restart handling.
Project settings protect unsaved edits; inactive Git panels poll less often and diff colors follow your theme.
